newsitem.title: USA: W.H. Brady financial officer resigns.
newsitem.headline: W.H. Brady financial officer resigns.

text.p: W.H. Brady Co said Tuesday that its chief financial officer and senior vice president Donald DeLuca will leave the company to pursue other interests, effective December 31.
DeLuca joined Brady in May 1990 as vice president and chief financial officer.

Earlier today, the company reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended October 31, 1996 rose to $6.5 million or $0.30 a share from $6.3 million or $0.29 in the same period last year. Sales for the fiscal 1997 first quarter rose 22.7 percent to $97.2 million.
W.H. Brady makes and markets labels, printing systems, label-application systems, and signs.

Profits grew in the quarter due to cost controls and improved asset utilization, the company said. Results are expected to improve further benefiting from acquisitions and a global network the company has established.

Global expansion continues to be a core growth strategy, said Katherine Hudson, W.H. Brady president, in a statement. During the quarter, the company opened a joint venture in Korea and has established operations in Malaysia, Taiwan and Brazil.
